awakening.name: Bygone Days
awakening.on_use_text:
[Before Attack] At 4+ highest Reson., gain +1 Atk Weight
- If the said Reson. was a Gloom Reson., gain +1 Atk Weight
[Attack End] Heal 2 allies with the lowest HP percentages by (10 + ([Sinking] on the main target + [Sinking] Count on the main target)/3)% HP (max 20%)
- If the highest Reson. was a 4+ Gloom Reson., heal 10% more of the max HP
coin_texts:
[On Hit] Inflict +3 [Sinking] Count
[On Hit] Inflict 2 [Curse]
[On Hit] At 4+ Gloom Reson., inflict 1 [Gloom Fragility]
[On Hit] Inflict 2 [The Uninvited]

corrosion.name: Bygone Days
corrosion.on_use_text:
[Indiscriminate]
Prioritizes targets that have the most [Sinking]
[Before Attack] Lose HP by 10% of Max HP (does not get Staggered due to this effect)
[Attack End] Heal 3 other allies with the lowest HP percentages by (10 + ([Sinking] on the main target + [Sinking] Count on the main target)/3)% HP (max 15%)
- At 4+ highest Reson., heal 1 additional ally
- If the said Reson. was a Gloom Reson., heal an additional 5% HP
coin_texts:
[On Hit] Inflict +3 [Sinking] Count
[On Hit] Inflict 2 [Curse]
[On Hit] For every 3 Gloom Reson., inflict 1 [Gloom Fragility] (max 2)
[On Hit] Inflict 2 [The Uninvited]
[On Hit] Inflict 2 [Echoes of the Manor] next turn
